test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Identify the WRONG pair of dancer and the related dance form from the following.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kumkum Dhar - Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kumkum Dhar** is not associated with the dance form **Kuchipudi**.
 
• **Kuchipudi** is a classical Indian dance form originating from **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• Notable exponents of Kuchipudi include **Yamini Krishnamurthy, Raja Reddy, and Radha Reddy**.
 
• **Meenakshi Chitharanjan** is a renowned Bharatanatyam dancer.
 
• **Sruti Bandopadhay** is associated with Manipuri dance.
 
• **Trilochan Mohanta** is known for his expertise in Chhau dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi** requires intense practice and is characterized by fast rhythms and fluid movements, creating a blend of control and abandon, strength and delicacy.
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is one of the oldest classical dance traditions in India, known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
• **Manipuri** dance is known for its graceful and fluid movements and is deeply connected with the rituals and traditional festivals of Manipur.
 
• **Chhau** is a semi-classical Indian dance with martial, tribal, and folk origins, often performed during regional festivals.
